## Description (first paragraph)

Install and configure [rtk-ai/rtk](https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk) — a single-binary Rust CLI proxy that wraps ~100 shell commands (`git`, `gh`, `npm`, `vitest`, `tsc`, `docker`, `grep`, `cat`, etc.) and strips redundant output before it reaches Claude's context. Typical savings: 60–90% on the exact commands PRISM sessions burn on (`npm run build`, `npx vitest run`, `git diff`, `gh api`).
